status: REG06 target semantics reviewed; existing sysfs/cache and dump paths rejected; executable device protocol not admitted

facts: REG06 fields are R/W configuration, with no documented read-clear behavior in its table
VREG bits 7:2, offset 3840000 uV, step 16000 uV, clamped at code 48
REG0C fault history changes on read; broad register dumps require that admitted effect separately

retained_configuration.scope: configuration retained with the matched captured boot kernel; no current module loading or device enumeration

compiled_read_paths.show: prints shared cached byte; no I2C transaction
compiled_read_paths.store_read: nonempty byte count <=3 selects parse/read branch; ignores parse and read-interface return and returns original byte count
compiled_read_paths.store_write: count >3 selects config update branch; not admitted
compiled_read_paths.read_interface: starts temporary byte at zero, calls byte reader, writes masked result to caller even on error, returns byte-reader status
compiled_read_paths.read_byte: two-message one-byte address-pointer / one-byte read request through i2c_transfer under driver I2C mutex; exactly two completed messages maps to 1, other results to -1
compiled_read_paths.dump: starts REG02 bit7 ADC conversion on both paths; full branch reads REG00..REG14 including read-sensitive REG0C; returned read results ignored

proposed_observer.status: design only, not implemented or device-admitted
proposed_observer.target: one REG06 byte through bq25890_read_byte, not read_interface or sysfs shared cache
proposed_observer.result: retain the helper return beside its own byte; value absent unless return equals 1; no retry or policy write
pending: Pin exact transport implementation, internal retry/timeouts and resource effects
Default-off one-shot entry and attributable boot/driver identity
Focused failure/short-transfer tests and clean pushed Buildbox compile

c2a_implication: The planned full REG00..REG14 map includes REG0C fault-history consumption; admit that effect and preserve the first result without treating it as uniformly passive. Do not invoke the vendor dump or discard REG0C silently.
limitations: No live charger transaction or latched REG06 state established
Register read semantics do not prove adapter ownership, timeout or retry budgets
Read does not establish cell chemistry or safety of a charging policy
User-space timeout does not bound a kernel I2C transaction or establish successful cleanup
redactions: Normalized facts and checksums only; binary/disassembly, PDF bytes, configuration and raw captures remain private.
